name: ruflo
description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a management layer: it can split a big job across many AI 'workers' that remember past tasks and coordinate with each other, instead of starting from scratch every time.
buyer: A technical founder or engineering lead already using Claude Code or Codex who wants to run many coordinated AI agents on a large codebase instead of one agent at a time.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop uses it to run several specialized agents (one for tests, one for refactoring, one for docs) in parallel on a client's large legacy codebase, cutting delivery time.
A startup building its own AI product uses its memory and routing layer as the backbone so their product's agents learn from past tasks instead of repeating mistakes.
An agency offering 'AI dev team as a service' uses the swarm coordination to credibly promise clients faster turnaround than a single human-plus-one-agent setup.

money_ideas.idea: Offer the connected 'ruOS Desktop' and hosted console as a paid managed service for teams that don't want to self-host the orchestration layer.
Sell consulting to wire it into a specific client's codebase and CI pipeline as a one-off integration project.

steal_this: It's deep developer infrastructure, not a consumer product; the realistic move is using it to deliver client dev work faster, then charging for the speed, not for the tool itself.
